proves.claim: Clause 1 [C7]: after two state builds of a board with 200,000 events the cached state holds no array of every event and reaches no event row per event, while the second, extending build returns the same state as a full rebuild.

api.main.state-cache-keeps-no-history.why: Without this test, the API state cache could again keep the whole event history between builds, which ran the view's API worker out of a 4 GB heap on a 770k-event board.
